stb — single-file public domain libraries (header subset).

Upstream:    https://github.com/nothings/stb
Version:     unversioned master snapshot, 2021-10-07 (commit 59114069);
             per-header versions apply (e.g. stb_truetype.h v1.26)
License:     MIT or Public Domain, dual (LICENSE)
Contents:    20 headers picked for the engine's needs (image, truetype,
             rect pack, ds, etc.) plus engine wrapper CMakeLists.txt
Consumed by: image decode helpers, font/atlas tooling, misc utilities
Update:      copy individual headers as needed; no coherent tree sync
